name: Mix Pilot
author: christopheb38
summary: Next-track suggestions: what mixes best after the playing track, by key, tempo, style and real DJ transitions.
description:
Shows the tracks that mix best after the playing one, on BROWSE and SEARCH and in the Mod Menu: the best next tracks, or a chain where each track mixes into the next. It scores key (Camelot), tempo, style (Last.fm tags, shared playlists) and transitions DJs really play: yours, learned as you mix, and a community pairings file.

Reads deck state and the USB library (read-only), writes its own files in its USB data folder, and uses WiFi for Last.fm and an optional pairings URL. No code patches, no change to controls, LEDs or audio.
